standard.riskScope: Declared bounded fixed SI scalar cycle-frequency conversion; no angular-frequency or consequential prediction claim. A recorded applicability/obligation screen remains necessary.
standard.ordinaryRoute: Competent independent technical/source engineering review can suffice for bounded arithmetic when complete sources/applicability and verification are established and no qualified external mandate applies.
standard.humanOnlyRequirement: No blanket human-only requirement for ordinary engineering review is established by the inspected policy. The schema uses identity strings, not authenticated personhood or qualification checks. Amendment rule5 allows agents to perform engineering review; forbids impersonating clinicians, regulated professionals or human qualified signatories.
standard.independence: Prospective assessor rejects reviewerId===authorId. Amendment requires a named independent competent reviewer with exact inspected evidence. Distinct strings alone do not substantiate actual independence, identity or competence.
standard.externalSpecialist: Not universal for standard #440 conversion; required when applicable mandate/high-consequence or unresolved qualified applicability requires it. Existing justified-NA reasoning is not a signed obligation screen or fabricated exemption.
standard.policyEffect: risk-review-2026-10-26 amendment is explicitly proposed/not production-effective; assessor is prospective/offline and cannot authenticate, certify, publish or replace live gates.
standard.soleOwnerException: Only project-level independent PR review may be excepted under recorded conditions. It does not waive substantive review or GitHub protections and cannot supply missing calculator QA/source/certification evidence.
